# Watermark maker

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/watermark/

Place a name, handle or brand label over an image. Adjust size, opacity, color and position, or use a repeating text watermark.

## How to use it

1. Choose your image or enter your own text.
2. Pick a layout, style or output size.
3. Create the result and download your shareable image.

## Example

Add @yourname to the bottom-right corner of a photo before sharing it online.

## Limits and checks

A watermark labels an image but cannot prevent copying or editing. Choose a readable color and avoid covering important details.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
